title: Stale .signals.json references remain in reasoning review phase after signals file elimination
description: Phase 5b step 6 (run.skill.md), Phase 7b step 6 (spec.skill.md), and Phase 7b step 6 (fix_signal.skill.md) still instruct agents to 'Read .moeb/signals/<run_id>.signals.json, append the reasoning signal objects to the array, and write the complete updated file.' These files no longer exist after the signal-catalogue-id-based-naming spec eliminated run-level .signals.json files. When the reasoning review phase fires in a future session, agents will encounter a file-read error and the reasoning signals will not be persisted.
proposed_resolution: Update Phase 5b step 6 in run.skill.md, Phase 7b step 6 in spec.skill.md, and Phase 7b step 6 in fix_signal.skill.md to: instead of reading/writing the signals array file, add each reasoning signal to the emittedSignals array in the run file. Specifically replace the step with: 'After all reasoning signals are processed via the Canonical Signal Dedup-and-Write Procedure, update the run file's emittedSignals array to include each reasoning signal { "id": signal_id, "description": title }.'
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000064: consolidated signal for signal lifecycle management process covering status transitions, dedup, and archive.
